title: standardized surfaces and stock

specimens.name: Factory-painted cold-rolled steel plate
specimens.description: rectangular industrial-gray steel sample with a smooth sprayed enamel finish, clean rolled edges and only faint non-corrosive service scuffs; no rust or orange oxidation

specimens.name: Olive-gray factory-painted steel panel
specimens.description: uniform utilitarian coating with only a few tiny edge chips exposing clean steel; no joints, fasteners, rust or orange oxidation

specimens.name: Safety-yellow folded sheet-metal sample
specimens.description: broad safety-yellow rectangular sheet coupon with one narrow 90-degree return flange along one short edge; the broad flat face must dominate; NOT an angle profile and NOT a constant L-section; smooth paint, no holes or attached hardware

specimens.name: Short galvanized steel angle profile
specimens.description: short unpainted galvanized equal-leg L-section with two narrow legs of equal width, uniform thickness, zinc-spangle metal finish and a clean factory-cut end; absolutely no yellow paint, no holes or fasteners

specimens.name: Short anodized aluminium U-channel extrusion
specimens.description: straight repeatable profile with a clean machined end and clean anodized finish; no attached hardware, rust or orange oxidation

specimens.name: Short square steel box-section
specimens.description: standardized hollow section with a clean factory-cut end and even gray primer; no fasteners, rust or orange oxidation

specimens.name: Molded phenolic / early industrial-plastic spacer block
specimens.description: rectangular dark-brown/black molded block with one clean functional through-bore, no metal inserts

specimens.name: Molded neoprene vibration pad
specimens.description: thick black rectangular rubber pad with crisp molded edges and shallow functional ribbing, no metal inserts

global_forbidden: text, letters, numbers, logos or pseudo-writing
whole machines, complete buildings, rooms or staged scenes
baked cast shadows, glow, bloom, rays or temporary FX
welds, bolts, rivets, hinges, brackets, hatches or grilles
pipes, valves, hoses, cables, connectors, gears, motors, bearings, instruments, switches or lamps
visible rust, orange oxidation, heavy chipping, distressed patina or hand-cut scars on any specimen

era_contract.character: standardized factory stock, repeatable dimensions, controlled coatings, clean bends/extrusions and early industrial polymers
required_signals: early industrial polymer and rubber stock
forbidden_regressions: heavy rust or hand-cut scars as dominant cues
weld beads or fasteners on stock samples
cream or beige flat plate replacing the safety-yellow folded sample
yellow-painted angle replacing the unpainted galvanized L-profile
